findings.title: Item-Level COGS and Gross Profit Analysis (Mar 23-30, 2026)
findings.claim: During the analysis period (Mar 23-30, 2026), total gross profit across all items was SAR 31516.75 on revenue of SAR 45104.05, representing a 69.88% gross margin. Top 3 profit contributors: Spanish Latte (SAR 3855.60), Chicken Sandwich (SAR 3055.20), Halloumi Toast (SAR 2772.60).
coverage_notes: Refunds explicitly excluded from revenue and COGS calculations
All items with known SKU and menu cost included
assumptions: Menu unit costs are current and applicable to analysis period
Line-item unit_price_sar and quantity are accurate
No adjustments for waste, shrinkage, or promotional cost-absorption beyond recorded discounts

findings.title: Quantified Waste Cost Impact (Mar 23-30, 2026)
findings.claim: During the analysis period, 6 items with non-null waste records incurred a total known waste cost of SAR 1363.30 (3.02% of period revenue). This represents 217 units wasted. Waste cost is calculated from inventory.known_waste_cost_sar for records with units_wasted > 0 only.
coverage_notes: Only records with known_waste_cost_sar populated included
Revenue denominator: POS sales (refunds excluded) for same period
Waste records sourced from inventory.known_waste_cost_sar; no refund or data quality filtering applied at inventory level
assumptions: Waste units include all non-null inventory loss records, which may include spoilage, disposal, shrinkage, and potential data entry errors
known_waste_cost_sar reflects recorded economic cost of waste
No recovery value assumed for wasted units
Inventory waste records are period-aligned with POS sales
Unit costs in inventory records are current as of analysis period start (2026-03-23)
